name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: A color picker with area, sliders, swatches, eye dropper, and field inputs. Uses namespace exports: ColorPicker.Root, ColorPicker.Area, ColorPicker.Slider, ColorPicker.SliderTrack, ColorPicker.Thumb, ColorPicker.Field, ColorPicker.Swatch, ColorPicker.SwatchPicker, ColorPicker.SwatchPickerItem, ColorPicker.EyeDropperButton.

docs.lead: A color picker with area, sliders, swatches, eye dropper, and field inputs.
docs.usage:
import * as ColorPicker from "@/components/ui/color-picker"
import { parseColor } from 'react-aria-components'

const [color, setColor] = React.useState(parseColor('hsl(228, 100%, 60%)'))

<ColorPicker.Root value={color} onChange={setColor}>
  <ColorPicker.Area colorSpace="hsl" xChannel="saturation" yChannel="lightness">
    <ColorPicker.Thumb />
  </ColorPicker.Area>
  <ColorPicker.Slider colorSpace="hsl" channel="hue">
    <ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
      <ColorPicker.Thumb />
    </ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
  </ColorPicker.Slider>
</ColorPicker.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Standalone color picker with area, sliders, channel inputs, and swatches.
examples.code:
<ColorPicker.Root value={color} onChange={setColor}>
  <ColorPicker.Area colorSpace="hsl" xChannel="saturation" yChannel="lightness">
    <ColorPicker.Thumb />
  </ColorPicker.Area>
  <ColorPicker.Slider colorSpace="hsl" channel="hue">
    <ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
      <ColorPicker.Thumb />
    </ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
  </ColorPicker.Slider>
</ColorPicker.Root>

examples.title: In a Popover
examples.description: Color picker inside a popover triggered by a button.
examples.code:
<ColorPicker.Root value={color} onChange={setColor}>
  <Popover.Root>
    <Popover.Trigger asChild>
      <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
        <Button.Icon as={ColorPicker.Swatch} />
        Pick color
      </Button.Root>
    </Popover.Trigger>
    <Popover.Content>...</Popover.Content>
  </Popover.Root>
</ColorPicker.Root>

examples.title: With Form Field
examples.description: Color picker composed with FormField for consistent label and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root label="Brand Color" hint="Choose your brand primary color.">
  <ColorPicker.Root value={color} onChange={setColor}>
    <ColorPicker.Area colorSpace="hsl" xChannel="saturation" yChannel="lightness">
      <ColorPicker.Thumb />
    </ColorPicker.Area>
    <ColorPicker.Slider colorSpace="hsl" channel="hue">
      <ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
        <ColorPicker.Thumb />
      </ColorPicker.SliderTrack>
    </ColorPicker.Slider>
  </ColorPicker.Root>
</FormField.Root>

api.name: ColorPicker.Root
api.description: The root color picker context provider (React Aria ColorPicker).

api.name: ColorPicker.Area
api.description: 2D color area for selecting two color channels.

api.name: ColorPicker.SliderTrack
api.description: The slider track with checkered transparency background.

api.name: ColorPicker.Thumb
api.description: Draggable thumb for area and sliders.

api.name: ColorPicker.Field
api.description: Color field input for direct value entry.

api.name: ColorPicker.Swatch
api.description: Color swatch preview with checkered transparency background.

api.name: ColorPicker.SwatchPickerItem
api.description: Individual swatch item in the picker.

props.name: color
props.description: The color value for this swatch

api.name: ColorPicker.EyeDropperButton
api.description: Button that opens the browser EyeDropper API. Returns null if unsupported.
